entities.title: zazzled
entities.summary: The daemon half of zazzle, a file tool for agents: one Rust crate that builds the zazzled binary (socket daemon, MCP server, MCP proxy, command runner, LaunchAgent installer and in-process runner), which also builds, tests and runs sandboxed zazz scripts.
entities.purpose: Holds the zazzled crate of the Cargo workspace in macos/rust: Cargo.toml (dependencies, each commented with its one reason), the README with setup, commands, the C#, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Dart, Rust, Go, Java, HTML, Razor, CSS and SCSS terse views, symbols, clean, run, the MCP proxy, stored outputs, zazz scripts, sessions, safety notes, limits, measurements and test commands for zazzle and zazzled together, ZAZZ-PLAN.md (the design of zazz scripts, with what this branch implements and where it deviates), coverage.sh (the branch-coverage gate, for zazzled or another crate named on its command line) and the source in src/.
boundaries: The client half, the C invoker `zazzle`, is a separate program in macos/c/zazzle; the two share only the wire protocol, which this crate defines, and the invoker's exec of `zazzled proxy` and `zazzled wrap`. The same invoker run as `zazz`, or under an installed script's name, sends zazz requests.
The terse C# view and the structure tools' answers come from zazzle-csharp-indexer (macos/dotnet/zazzle-csharp-indexer), a separate program reached over its own socket.

zazz scripts run in zazz-worker (macos/rust/zazz-worker), a separate binary found beside zazzled, or natively when signed by an authority trusted for native code; zazzled builds them with the user's rustc. The .zazz format comes from macos/rust/zazz-format and the script protocol from macos/rust/zazz-sdk, whose sources zazzled also embeds and compiles for scripts.
Builds and releases run from the workspace and the repository's workflows, not from this folder.
